summary: Performs PCA on z-scored neural activity, clusters neurons by PC loadings, and aligns results with CePNEM behavioral tuning for a specified experimental animal.
use_when: run PCA and cluster neurons for animal 2022-04-12-04
generate a heatmap of PC loadings and CePNEM behavioral tuning
hierarchically cluster neural data using top 5 PCA components
analyze neural population dynamics using CePNEM model outputs
visualize behavioral tuning and PCA loading similarity for a specific session
avoid_when: Neural and behavioral measurements cannot be aligned on a common time base
A low-dimensional embedding alone would be treated as confirmatory statistical evidence
